# SandBase - Expanded API Guide for AI Agents

> Common SandBase API workflows for AI agents. The complete machine-readable contract is https://www.sandbase.ai/docs/openapi.yaml. Base URL: https://api.sandbase.ai/v1

## Authentication

All requests require: Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY

## Terminology

- Task: A billable execution record. Not every API operation creates one.
- Run: A model generation request via POST /v1/run. May be synchronous or asynchronous.
- Session: An agent execution via POST /v1/sessions. Stateful multi-turn workflow.

Some billable operations return an x-task-id response header. Not every API operation creates a task.

---

## Connect AI Tools

Source: https://github.com/sandbaseai/cli

Use the guided Console flow to select an AI tool and see its current prerequisites, installation method, and verification steps:

https://www.sandbase.ai/console/setup

For a CLI-supported client such as Codex:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://sandbase.ai/install.sh | sh -s -- --client codex
```

Read-only installer client catalog:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://sandbase.ai/install.sh | sh -s -- --list-agents
```

Diagnose a CLI-managed client:

```sh
npx -y @sandbaseai/cli doctor --client codex
```

Installation or authorization does not prove that the target client is connected. Inspect the SandBase entry and its discovered tools in the client, then complete one safe natural-language tool request.

Connect AI tools: https://www.sandbase.ai/docs/setup/

---

## POST /v1/chat/completions

OpenAI-compatible chat. Streaming, tools, vision, reasoning, and structured-output support depend on the selected model.

Request:
```
curl https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai/gpt-5.4",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
    "max_tokens": 500
  }'
```

Response:
```
{
  "id": "chatcmpl-abc123",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "model": "openai/gpt-5.4",
  "choices": [{
    "index": 0,
    "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "..."},
    "finish_reason": "stop"
  }],
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 24, "completion_tokens": 89, "total_tokens": 113}
}
```

---

## POST /v1/messages

Anthropic-compatible Messages API. Caching and other optional features depend on the selected model.

Request:
```
curl https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/messages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5",
    "max_tokens": 1024,
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is SandBase?"}]
  }'
```

Response:
```
{
  "id": "msg_abc123",
  "type": "message",
  "role": "assistant",
  "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "SandBase is..."}],
  "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5",
  "stop_reason": "end_turn",
  "usage": {"input_tokens": 12, "output_tokens": 64}
}
```

---

## POST /v1/embeddings

OpenAI-compatible text embeddings.

Request:
```
curl https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "<embedding-model-id>",
    "input": "SandBase is an AI agent platform."
  }'
```

Response:
```
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [{"object": "embedding", "index": 0, "embedding": [0.0023, -0.0091, ...]}],
  "model": "<embedding-model-id>",
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 7, "total_tokens": 7}
}
```

---

## POST /v1/run

Unified generation endpoint. The model field determines output type (image, video, audio).
Check response status: "completed" = done; "pending" or "running" = poll GET /v1/run/{id}.

Image example:
```
curl https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "bfl/flux-2/flash",
    "prompt": "A futuristic city at sunset",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```

Response (sync):
```
{
  "id": "f3d2e8a1-7c4b-4a12-9d2e-123456789abc",
  "status": "completed",
  "model": "bfl/flux-2/flash",
  "outputs": [{"url": "https://cdn.sandbase.ai/outputs/f3d2e8a1-7c4b-4a12-9d2e-123456789abc.png", "content_type": "image/png"}]
}
```

Video example (async):
```
curl https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "kwaivgi/kling-video/3.0/turbo/standard/text-to-video", "prompt": "A drone over mountains", "duration": 5}'
```

Response: {"id": "6a7b9c10-2d3e-4f50-8a61-23456789abcd", "status": "running"}
Poll: GET /v1/run/6a7b9c10-2d3e-4f50-8a61-23456789abcd until status = "completed"

Audio example:
```
curl https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "bytedance/seed-speech/tts/2.0", "text": "Hello world"}'
```

Response:
```
{
  "id": "7b8c0d21-3e4f-5061-9b72-3456789abcde",
  "status": "completed",
  "outputs": [{"url": "https://cdn.sandbase.ai/outputs/7b8c0d21-3e4f-5061-9b72-3456789abcde.mp3", "content_type": "audio/mpeg"}]
}
```

---

## GET /v1/models

List enabled logical models in the OpenAI-compatible model-list format. The endpoint is not paginated and defaults
to type=llm. The response contains object="list" and data items with id, object, created, and owned_by. Use the item
id as the logical model name, then retrieve it for capabilities, schemas, and pricing.

---

## GET /v1/models/{id_or_name}

Get full details for a specific model. The response adds unified_schema, supported_modes, and model_card. Detailed
prices live inside model_card; there is no top-level pricing object.

Example: GET /v1/models/openai/gpt-5.4

## GET /v1/tasks/{id}/cost

Check recorded task cost using the task ID returned by the API operation.

Example: GET /v1/tasks/f3d2e8a1-7c4b-4a12-9d2e-123456789abc/cost

Response:
```
{
  "id": "f3d2e8a1-7c4b-4a12-9d2e-123456789abc",
  "status": "completed",
  "settled": true,
  "currency": "USD",
  "cost": "0.000325",
  "estimated_cost": "0.000325",
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 24,
    "completion_tokens": 89,
    "total_tokens": 113,
    "cached_tokens": 0,
    "cache_creation_tokens": 0,
    "reasoning_tokens": 0
  }
}
```

---

## POST /v1/agents

Create an agent.

Request:
```
curl -X POST https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/agents \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Research Assistant",
    "model": "openai/gpt-5.4",
    "system": "You are a research assistant.",
    "tools": [{"type": "agent_toolset_20260401"}]
  }'
```

Response:
```
{"id": "agent_abc123", "type": "agent", "name": "Research Assistant", "version": 1}
```

## GET /v1/agents - List agents
## GET /v1/agents/{id} - Get agent
## POST /v1/agents/{id} - Update agent
## POST /v1/agents/{id}/archive - Archive agent
## GET /v1/agents/{id}/versions - List versions

---

## POST /v1/endpoints/{id}/run

Invoke a Service by creating or continuing a Session and sending one message.

Endpoint invocation accepts an optional session_id. When omitted, SandBase creates a new persistent Session. A supplied Session must come from the same Service and match its current Agent-version binding. Invocation does not create a separate public Run identity.

Request:
```
curl -X POST https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/endpoints/ep_abc/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "Summarize the latest AI news"}'
```

Default response (`202 Accepted`):
```
{"session_id":"sess_abc123","events":[{"id":"sevt_abc123","type":"user.message","processed_at":"2026-08-03T10:00:00Z"}]}
```

---

## POST /v1/sessions

Create an Agent Session. `agent` is required; runtime binding is resolved internally from the Agent. Use `initial_events` to send the first message during creation.

POST /v1/sessions creates the persistent public Session and returns session_id. Events, SSE, archive, and delete all address that same Session. Archived history remains readable but rejects new events; deleted Sessions return 404.

Request:
```
curl -X POST https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/sessions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"agent": "agent_abc123", "title": "GitHub research", "initial_events":[{"type":"user.message","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Research AI coding tools"}]}]}'
```

Response:
```
{"id":"sess_xyz789","type":"session","agent_id":"agent_abc123","status":"idle"}
```

## POST /v1/sessions/{id}/events

Send a message to start or continue an idle Session, or send `user.interrupt` to interrupt a running turn.

Request: {"events":[{"type":"user.message","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Focus on AI coding tools"}]}]}
Response: {"data":[{"id":"sevt_001","type":"user.message","processed_at":"2026-08-03T10:00:00Z"}]}

## GET /v1/sessions - List sessions
## GET /v1/sessions/{id} - Get session details
## GET /v1/sessions/{id}/events - List all events

## GET /v1/sessions/{id}/events/stream

Replay persisted events and then stream newly persisted events. While idle, the server may send `: heartbeat` comments. The connection remains open until the client disconnects, the request context is cancelled, or a write fails; terminal Session state does not emit a separate close event.

Event format:
```
data: {"id":"sevt_001","type":"agent.message","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I'll search GitHub..."}],"processed_at":"2026-08-03T10:00:01Z"}
: heartbeat
data: {"id":"sevt_002","type":"session.status_idle","stop_reason":{"type":"end_turn"},"processed_at":"2026-08-03T10:00:02Z"}
```

---

## POST /v1/deployments

Create a Schedule through the `/v1/deployments` compatibility resource. Each trigger creates a distinct drun_* DeploymentRun and attempts to create exactly one new sess_* Session.

Request:
```
{"name":"Daily summary","agent_id":"agent_abc123","initial_events":[{"type":"user.message","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Generate the daily summary"}]}],"schedule":{"type":"cron","expression":"0 9 * * *","timezone":"America/New_York"}}
```

Response:
```
{"id": "depl_abc123", "status": "active", "next_run_at": "2026-08-03T09:00:00-04:00"}
```

## POST /v1/deployments/{id}/runs - Create a manual DeploymentRun
## GET /v1/deployments/{id}/runs - List DeploymentRuns for one Deployment
## GET /v1/deployment_runs - List DeploymentRuns; supports trigger_type=manual|schedule and status=pending|succeeded|failed filters

The public DeploymentRun object contains id, type, deployment_id, agent, trigger_context, nullable session_id, nullable error, and created_at. Its current response shape does not include a status field.

## GET /v1/skills - List available skills

---

## Model Categories & Pricing

Model availability, capabilities, context limits, and pricing change independently. Do not infer that every LLM
supports streaming, vision, tools, structured output, or caching.

Use GET /v1/models to discover the current catalog, then GET /v1/models/{id_or_name} for the authoritative model card,
capability tags, input schema, and pricing before sending a request.

---

## Error Handling

Error bodies are protocol-specific. Core middleware may return {"error":"message"}; Agent resource APIs return
{"error":{"type":"...","message":"..."}}; OpenAI and Anthropic gateways retain compatible envelopes.

| Message/type | HTTP | Description |
| missing API key in Authorization header | 401 | Standard endpoint requires a Bearer token |
| invalid API key | 401 | Key is unknown |
| API key has been revoked | 401 | Key is disabled |
| API key has expired | 401 | Key is past expiration |
| insufficient_scope | 403 | Scoped key is not authorized for this endpoint |
| API key rate limit exceeded | 429 | Optional per-key RPM cap exceeded; back off with jitter |
| global rate limit exceeded | 429 | Platform-wide RPM protection exceeded; back off with jitter |
| API key spending limit exceeded | 402 or protocol-specific 403 | Key spending limit reached |
| HTTP 400 | Invalid or unsupported input; fix the request using the endpoint and model schema |
| HTTP 404 | Model or resource not found; verify current IDs before retrying |
| HTTP 409 | Resource state conflict; read current state before deciding whether retry is safe |
| HTTP 5xx | SandBase or upstream failure; retry only when the operation is safe to repeat |

Retry strategy: bounded exponential backoff plus random jitter.
The API does not currently send Retry-After or X-RateLimit-* headers and has no published universal numeric default.
Do not retry unchanged 400, 401, 402, 403, or 404 requests. Check idempotency before repeating create, trigger, or external-action requests.

---

## Billing

- Read each model's current pricing formula and units from its model_card
- Token-priced models can include input, output, cache, or reasoning components when declared
- Media and other models can use per-request, duration, resolution, or other model-specific units
- Check cost: GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}/cost
- API key spending controls: https://www.sandbase.ai/console/keys
- Usage and cost: https://www.sandbase.ai/console/activities?tab=usage
- Balance and credit transactions: https://www.sandbase.ai/console/billing
